description: Product Name: Power BI Card based Data Visualization Object Version: 1.0.0 Release date: November 19, 2024 Developer: [Infortime Shiqin] Product Description: This product is an advanced card style data visualization object tailored for Power BI users, aiming to provide a concise and intuitive way of displaying data. By integrating advanced card design concepts, this object can efficiently present key data points while maintaining visual clarity and aesthetics. Users can customize the style and content of cards according to their needs to meet the requirements of different business scenarios. Main functions: Data driven visualization: Users can directly extract key data points from the data model of Power BI, achieving real-time and dynamic data display. Highly customizable: Provides rich customization options, including card background color, font style, data point color, etc., allowing users to customize display effects based on brand or personal style. Interactivity: Supports interactive operations such as clicking and hovering, allowing users to delve into data details and enhance the user experience. Responsive design: Card based visual objects can adapt to different display devices and resolutions, ensuring a consistent visual experience on various screens.
